description.text: Tuition will be RMB 40,000 per year if taught in English.

duration.text: The Civil Professional Management at Dalian University of Technology is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4583 USD/per year ￥ 33000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Certificate of HSK (No need for English taught programs) Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Postgraduate school transcript Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: Applicants must 1. Hold a master's degree, 2. Be in good health 3. Be under the age of 45 4. Have passed Chinese level of HSK5 or above (There are no HSK requirements for those who applied for courses taught in English)
